profiles.name: Ravi
profiles.role: Auto driver. Late shift, KIA airport. Built like a wire. Has been doing this for 14 years and you are not the first foreigner he's met.
profiles.speaker: hitesh

profiles.name: Anna
profiles.role: Chai stall owner near Indiranagar metro. Friendly, asks everyone where they're from. Used to be in IT, quit, never looked back.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Amma
profiles.role: Your Kannadiga roommate's mother. Visiting from Mysuru. Speaks slow formal Kannada. Will absolutely catch you if you use અਉ instead of અఈಋಁ.
profiles.speaker: vidya

profiles.name: Narrator
profiles.role: Diegetic stage directions in English. Used sparingly.
profiles.speaker: anushka

profiles.name: Receptionist
profiles.role: Hotel front desk. Late 30s, has seen a thousand of you this month. Polite, slightly tired, very formal Kannada. Doesn't make jokes after midnight.
profiles.speaker: manisha

profiles.name: Rangaswamy
profiles.role: Broker. Late 20s. Talks fast, switches to English when cornered, sells you a flat he hasn't seen. Wears a Bluetooth even when not on a call.
profiles.speaker: abhilash

profiles.name: Krishnamurthy uncle
profiles.role: Owner of the second flat. Late 60s. Mysuru pronunciation, careful with money. Tests you politely. Has owned three flats since 1989.
profiles.speaker: karun

profiles.name: Lokesh
profiles.role: Your apartment building's watchman. Mid-50s, North Karnataka cadence. Knows everyone's schedule, every visitor, every delivery. Friendly, but he's watching.
profiles.speaker: hitesh

profiles.name: Vendor aunty
profiles.role: Sunday-morning vegetable vendor at the BTM market. 50s. Direct, no-nonsense, prices things by glancing at your shoes. Her bored granddaughter rings up the bill.
profiles.speaker: arya
